### Beneficial Power
Author: Joe Stowell
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/beneficial-power/
Passage: 2 Chronicles 16:9
Points:
- Earthly athletes showcase strength to prove superiority over others.
- God demonstrates His almighty power not through spectacles, but by helping those loyal to Him.
- Biblical history confirms God regularly uses His power to deliver and sustain His people.
- Believers can trust God to show His strength in life's challenges and should give Him glory.

### When God Does Not Draw Near
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/when-god-does-not-draw-near
Passage: 2 Chronicles 16:9
Points:
- Hanani’s words served as a sobering rebuke against King Asa's misplaced trust.
- God eagerly supports those who acknowledge personal weakness and treat Him as their first defense.
- Asa’s treaty with a foreign king revealed a prideful reliance on human solutions.
- Excluding God from our problems forfeits divine help and perpetuates conflict.
- Believers must respond to God's correction with humble repentance rather than stubborn defensiveness.
